workflows.scenario: Start a Bank Simulator session from the public NGPF landing page, confirm the account dashboard renders its checking and saving activity widgets, then view the checking account's read-only transaction activity.
preconditions: The public NGPF Bank Simulator at https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/home is reachable without prior authentication or account setup.

steps.action: Open the Bank Simulator landing page
steps.expected: The landing page displays the NGPF Bank Simulator introduction and a visible 'GET STARTED NOW' button
The app navigates to the Bank Simulator dashboard and a one-time welcome dialog is displayed
The dialog closes and the dashboard shows the Checking Account Activity widget with its available balance label and a 'VIEW ACCOUNT' control

steps.action: Open the checking account's read-only activity from the dashboard
steps.expected: The Account Activity page opens at type=checking with the 'Account Activity' heading, the 'Checking' account toggle, and the transaction table's 'Description' column displayed

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/account-activity.spec.ts#starts a simulator session and views checking account activity
